MATH_BEEZER_DEF_EO: Equation Operations. Given a system of linear equations, the following three operations will transform the system into a different one, and each operation is known as an equation operation. Swap the locations of two equations in the list of equations. Multiply each term of an equation by a nonzero quantity. Multiply each term of one equation by some quantity, and add these terms to a second equation, on both sides of the equality. Leave the first equation the same after this operation, but replace the second equation by the new one.
